title: Methane leaks
description: Stop the methane that leaks from oil and gas wells, pipelines and coal mines: per kg it warms far more than CO₂, but for only about a decade.

oilGasMethane.title: Oil and gas leaks
oilGasMethane.description: Find and fix leaks, and stop venting and routine flaring: 75% of the methane of oil and gas goes at 100% (IEA). Burning less oil and gas then leaves less methane to avoid.

coalMineMethane.title: Coal-mine methane
coalMineMethane.description: Drain the methane from coal seams before mining and burn what is left in the ventilation air: 50% of coal mines' methane goes at 100%.
